typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	fpinfradeliveryimporttbl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		{Provisioned Date} as string,
		Lookup as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		{App ID} as string,
		LCL_CI_TYPE_DISPLAY as string,
		New_NGDC_Strategy as string,
		Environment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		BAM_App_GUID as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		New_NGDC_Strategy as string,
		SPM_Demand_U_CI_TYPE as string,
		Provisioned_Date as string,
		DEVICE_Environment_Short as string,
		Detail_Status_Lookup as string,
		BAM_DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		BAM_App_GUID = BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID,
		importdate,
		New_NGDC_Strategy,
		SPM_Demand_U_CI_TYPE = LCL_CI_TYPE_DISPLAY,
		Provisioned_Date = {Provisioned Date},
		DEVICE_Environment_Short = Environment,
		Detail_Status_Lookup = Lookup,
		BAM_DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID = {App ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($fpinfradeliveryimporttbl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> fpinfradeliveryimporttbl
